bio.text: Troy Downing represents Montana's 2nd Congressional District in the U.S. House and is serving his first term.
Before Congress he was Montana State Auditor; earlier he founded a technology startup that merged with Yahoo, an insurance company and a commercial real estate firm.
He served eight years in the U.S. Air Force and Air National Guard with a Combat Search and Rescue squadron, including two tours in Afghanistan, and lives in Helena.
